moat_justification: Two global category leaders (KFC, Taco Bell) across 64,000 units in 157 countries, 97% franchised royalty toll with 40%+ returns on capital, scale purchasing/advertising leverage, Byte by Yum! tech platform and >60% digital mix raising franchisee switching friction, proven pricing power — against zero consumer switching costs and a QSR value war, franchisee-health dependence (Turkey termination closed 537 units at once), demonstrated brand decay (Pizza Hut being sold after years of negative comps), GLP-1 and food-safety headline risk, and 7.2x net leverage limiting downturn flexibility.
name: Yum! Brands Inc.
one_liner: Strong 7/10-moat franchisor (KFC + Taco Bell royalty toll, 40%+ ROIC) — but at $146.75 (25.3x TTM OE, 3.9% yield) the weighted IRR is only 8.1% with IV@15% of $62, even the super-bull case (12.1%) fails to clear 15%, and the real balance sheet carries ~$11.6B net debt (7.2x OE, BB+/Ba2) that the engine missed; it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$62, or ~$47 with a margin of safety.
